collegeInfo: IIM Mumbai (formerly NITIE Mumbai), established in 1963 with support from UNDP and ILO, became India’s 21st IIM in 2023. Located in Powai near Vihar Lake, it’s a leader in management education, especially in Operations, Supply Chain, Sustainability & Analytics.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Top 10 candidates with 95 percentile or above in CAT.
scholarships.applicationProcess:
Scholarship applications are processed during the first year of the program.
Selection is done through an internal process by the institute.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Students whose family income is less than ₹8 lakh per annum.

events.eventFullDescription: Avartan is IIM Mumbai’s flagship business fest featuring case competitions, quizzes, panel discussions, and business simulations, attracting participants from premier B-schools across India.
Sansmaran is IIM Mumbai’s annual alumni meet, reconnecting alumni across generations in an evening of nostalgia, networking, and storytelling.
A creative, on-campus fest featuring quizzes, crossword challenges, and interactive games—designed to sharpen intellectual and lateral thinking skills.

infrastructure.infraDescription: IIM Mumbai’s lush campus (~64 acres) in Powai features modern classrooms, library (55,000+ books, extensive e-resources), tallest hostel block (16 floors housing 800 students), auditoriums, sports facilities, fitness center, mess, cafeteria, and high-speed Wi-Fi across campus.
